title: Transparent Redstone
description: Makes redstone transparent if you want it to be hidden!
body: Take your Minecraft structures to the next level with this must-have utility resource pack aimed at removing visual disarray. With this pack, you'll be able to keep your structures looking beautiful with completely invisible Redstone dust and wiring. Are you fed up with wires ruining your flooring designs, or do you want to create those magic machines that seem to operate on their own without any wires or dust in sight?
